description: This is a test module for a FastAPI application that extensively demonstrates and tests various features of request body schemas, including examples, schema_extra configurations, path/query/header/cookie parameters, and their respective OpenAPI schema generation and validation.

classes.name: Item
classes.description: A Pydantic model with a schema_extra customization to include example data.

methods.name: create_app()
methods.description: Creates and returns a FastAPI app with multiple endpoints demonstrating the use of request body examples, schema configurations, and various parameter types.

methods.name: test_call_api()
methods.description: A test function that uses TestClient to send POST and GET requests to the app endpoints, asserting successful responses.

methods.name: test_openapi_schema()
methods.description: Verifies that the OpenAPI JSON schema correctly captures all examples, schema_extra configurations, and parameter overrides defined in the app.
